description: This file defines a custom subclass of SwipeRefreshLayout called MultiSwipeRefreshLayout that supports multiple child views as triggers for the swipe-to-refresh gesture. It allows specifying which child views should trigger refresh when swiped down and overrides the canChildScrollUp method to support multiple views.

classes.name: MultiSwipeRefreshLayout
classes.description: A custom layout extending SwipeRefreshLayout that manages multiple child views capable of triggering refresh gestures, providing enhanced control over swipe-to-refresh behavior with multiple views.

methods.name: setSwipeableChildren
methods.description: Sets the list of child view IDs that can trigger the swipe-to-refresh gesture, finding each view by its ID.

methods.name: canChildScrollUp
methods.description: Overrides the default method to determine if any of the configured swipeable child views can scroll up, which influences when the refresh gesture can start.

methods.name: canViewScrollUp
methods.description: Utility method to check if a specific view can scroll up, handling differences across platform versions and view types.
